primary_selection.shard_strata: Sort immutable inventory by (compressed bytes,path); four equally sized bands of 2048 shards
primary_selection.rule: Lowest SHA256(seed:shard:path) in each band; ties by path. Within each shard take the row group with lowest SHA256(seed:group:path:row_group_index); ties by index.
primary_selection.row_inclusion: For a row in shard i with Gi row groups: (4/2048)*(1/Gi). Retain Gi and inverse factor 512*Gi for each row; unequal row-group sizes must not be ignored.

repository_selection.unit: Repository row; preserve shard/group/row ordinal plus repo_path and commit_id. If repository/commit keys repeat, hold selection for frame reconciliation instead of silently collapsing or resampling.
repository_selection.strata: Actual retained file count (0-1,2-10,11-100,>100) x file license composition (all permissive,mixed,none permissive). Missing/unrecognized license labels count as not-labeled-permissive metadata for stratification only; preserve the unresolved label, not a rights decision.
repository_selection.rule: Within each nonempty observed-frame stratum, take min(4,Nh) lowest SHA256(seed:repo:shard_path:group_index:row_index), tie by row identity. Record Nh,nh and factor Nh/nh.
repository_selection.language_coverage: Record language and practical-role coverage and missing lanes; do not substitute examples to fill a desired language result.

file_selection.rule: Take min(2,F) lowest SHA256(seed:file:shard_path:group_index:row_index:file_index), tie by file index. Record F,f and factor F/f. Retain complete selected content externally.
file_selection.oversized: Keep selection and denominator; mark not reviewed under the cap. No truncation presented as whole-file review and no replacement.

review.natural_code: Intact useful content, practical role, language/length, source identity, notice applicability, redaction effects, source-family/benchmark flags and unresolved outcomes. Do not require independent executable tests for all natural source code.
review.verified_exercises: Separate gate; metadata, parsing or self-generated tests do not establish verified-exercise supply.
review.token_counts: Frozen Mistral model dadfd56d766715c61d2ef780a525ab43b8e6da4de6865bda3d95fdef5e134055; count actual selected text plus BOS/EOS and disclose serialization. Separate eligible tokens from observed tokens.

resource_bounds.scope: Prices cover selected Parquet ranges only. Original-source/notice requests and detailed review CPU time must be bounded and recorded separately; no full-release download.

failure_and_inference.policy: Never replace unavailable, oversized, malformed, held or failed selections. Preserve expected row counts from footers and report acquired rows and censored/unresolved rows separately. Content/hash mismatch invalidates the affected artifact.
failure_and_inference.weights: Retain primary factor 512*Gi, conditional repository factor Nh/nh and file factor F/f. Simple sample file/pass proportions are not release yield. Weight token outcomes directly; do not multiply a file pass rate by corpus tokens.
failure_and_inference.limits: Account for shard/repository clustering and tiny strata; no full-release eligible-yield estimate while source-use, exclusions or censored coverage remain unresolved. Do not pool the earlier diagnostic probes as fresh random observations.

evidence.integrity: Pinned HTTPS footer ranges and cached SHA256 checked; complete publisher shard hashes not verified.

next: Acquire only the 16 frozen row-group ranges within these caps; record complete frame metadata and freeze repository/file selections before semantic review.
